question: How many U.S. metropolitan areas will have Tesla robotaxi service on August 31, 2026?

Four more cities (Phoenix, Orlando, Tampa, Las Vegas) are listed as "Service announced, 1H 2026" but not yet live. The question resolves on Aug 31, 2026 — a ~6-week window. 'Five or fewer' = no net new qualifying metros; 'Six' = exactly one of the four announced cities launches; 'Seven or more' = two+ launch. Tesla shows strong recent burst capability (Miami launched July 3, 3 metros added April–July) but a chronic history of slipping self-imposed timelines — the four remaining "H1 2026" cities are already past their stated deadline. Safety-driver launches have a low regulatory bar, keeping the upside tail meaningful. Net-new-launch distribution over 6 weeks maps to roughly 40% (0 new), 34% (1 new), 26% (2+ new).
